findings.name: side-tab
findings.description: Thick colored border on one side of a card (the "alert" stripe)
findings.suggestion: Drop the stripe; separate with spacing or a full border

findings.name: contrast
findings.description: Text color against its background is below the WCAG ratio
findings.suggestion: Use a pair with at least 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text

findings.name: marker
findings.description: Work marker or placeholder left in the code (TODO-style words, "rest of the code")
findings.suggestion: Finish it or delete it; open an issue for real follow-ups

findings.name: debug-leftover
findings.description: Debug call left in the code (debugger, console.log in a file that does not log)
findings.suggestion: Remove it, or use the logger the project already has

findings.name: stock-vocabulary
findings.description: Stock marketing vocabulary (seamless, robust, elevate, empower, ...)
findings.suggestion: Say what it does in plain words, with a concrete fact
